topic: Changes in Materials When Disposed or Burned
key_concepts: Materials can be thrown away or burned.
Burning changes materials such as paper, leaves, twigs, and juice cartons.
Changes in materials can be observed by comparing before and after disposal or burning.
Improper trash disposal can harm people's health and safety.
Burning household materials can harm people.
Trash thrown in wrong places can harm animals.
Trash thrown in wrong places can harm plants.
Trash thrown in wrong places can harm the surroundings or environment.
Common trash materials include paper, glass, plastic, food waste, metal cans, and cartons.
